sloka: धनुर्गृहीत्वा तूणी च खड्गं च रुचिरप्रभम् ।निक्षिप्य नगरे वीरौ सौमित्रिभरतावुभौ ।। ७.७५.९ ॥
transliteration: dhanurgṛhītvā tūṇī ca khaḍgaṁ ca ruciraprabham ।nikṣipya nagare vīrau saumitribharatāvubhau ।। 7.75.9 ॥

translations.english: Having taken his bow, quiver, and a beautifully shining sword, and having left both heroes Lakshmana and Bharata in the city, (Rama proceeded).
